summary.zh-CN: 指导如何用 Python（FastMCP）或 Node/TypeScript（MCP SDK）构建高质量 MCP 服务器，覆盖工具设计、错误处理、评测与最佳实践；附完整参考文档。
summary.en: Guides building high-quality MCP servers in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK), covering tool design, error handling, evaluation, and best practices; full reference docs included.

modifications.zh-CN: frontmatter 只保留 name 与 description，去掉 license 字段。
modifications.en: Frontmatter keeps only name and description; the license field removed.

modifications.zh-CN: scripts/ 目录（connections.py、evaluation.py、example_evaluation.xml、requirements.txt）不随资源文件收录（构建拒绝脚本文件）；SKILL.md 开头加注说明评测脚本未包含，评测参考文档 reference/evaluation.md 随附（改动见最后一条）。
modifications.en: The scripts/ directory (connections.py, evaluation.py, example_evaluation.xml, requirements.txt) is not included (build rejects script files); a note is added to SKILL.md stating scripts are excluded; the evaluation reference doc reference/evaluation.md is included (see the last change).

modifications.zh-CN: reference/ 下 mcp_best_practices.md、node_mcp_server.md、python_mcp_server.md 三个参考文档原样收录，无修改。
modifications.en: reference/mcp_best_practices.md, node_mcp_server.md and python_mcp_server.md are included unchanged.

modifications.zh-CN: SKILL.md 两个章节标题与十处链接文字前的表情符号去掉，开头的说明同步更新；reference/evaluation.md 开头加修改说明，输出格式里标记答对、答错的两个符号改为文字 correct/incorrect。只改符号，不改内容。
modifications.en: Emoji before two headings and ten link labels in SKILL.md are removed and the note at the top is updated; reference/evaluation.md gets a change notice at the top, and the two symbols marking right and wrong answers in the output format are written as correct/incorrect. Only symbols change, not content.

conditions.zh-CN: 纯参考指南，不需要额外工具；实际构建 MCP 服务器需要 Python 或 Node.js 运行时，但这是用户的开发环境要求，不是技能加载要求。
conditions.en: Pure reference guide; no extra tools required to load. Building an actual MCP server requires Python or Node.js in the user's own development environment.
